many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

Example 11x11 with 3x3 tiles separated by zero lines: output 3x3 all background 5 except the one tile with two 8s becomes 1. A 19x11 grid with 4x3 tiles separated by color-2 lines yielded a 4x3 output preserving background 0 except two double-8 tiles became 1. Treat separator lines as structural and use tile counts; validated on one demonstration and a correctly solved test. Do not assume behavior for zero or >2 markers without evidence.", path="arc", global_=True)
print(entry)
